Lint decision (AC-6, also ADR 0001 D6): allowForKnownSafePromises: [{from:'package', package:'node:test'}] was empirically rejected — @types/node 26.6.5 types node:test's test() as lib Promise<void>, so the package-from specifier never matches (verified with typescript-eslint 8.71.1); scoping the same override to {from:'lib'} was rejected because it neuters no-floating-promises inside test bodies. The rule stays at plain 'error' with no carve-outs. Applied instead: 276 top-level test( sites codemodded to void test(...) (the rule's documented ignore operator; node:test tracks registration promises, so failures still surface), two await-less before(async ...) hooks made synchronous, 6 dead declarations removed, and the three complexity-11/12 hotspots refactored (extracted isDependencyCase/assertCase and assertVendoredLane/assertPackedLane helpers) instead of disabling or configuring away.
